messages:
Olivia: hey @ravi @sam - prepping the launch post and we need a quick engineering sanity check on the benchmark aggregation and warmup notes before we publish. can eng/runtime confirm the aggregation method used for P50/P95 and the warmup strategy?

Sam: can you paste the exact payloads and variants used for the headline numbers? marketing needs reproducible steps for the blog.

Olivia: sure - ran 3 seq buckets (short/med/long) and two build types (fp16, int8). sample payloads: 
```
# short
{"input": "Summarize: The product helps devs ship LLM features."}
# med
{"input": "Explain how Redwood reduces inference cost and latency for production apps."}
# long
{"input": "Simulated long context ~1024 tokens - multi-turn."}
```
run settings: batch=8, concurrency=16, steady_window=30s after warmup, repeats=5. models: rdx-13b-v1 + rdx-13b-v1-quant-int8. exported stats say we computed per-shard token throughput then took median across shards for P50/P95.

Ravi: quick clarification: when you say "median across shards" do you mean compute P50 per shard then median those P50s, or pool raw latencies across shards then compute P50/P95 on the combined set? they can diverge.

Olivia: marketing currently phrased it as "median of shard-level P50s" because we wanted stability vs a noisy host.

Ravi: eng-runtime prefers pooled (merged) latencies for user-level percentiles. we can produce both pooled and shard-median for slides. we'll also capture p99 for quantized runs and increase repeats to 5+ to reduce noise.

Jordan: also include cold-start behaviour (first 10 requests) and a streaming fallback simulation (1 token/sec) to catch buffer/backpressure artifacts.

Mia: marketing wants per-token GPU/CPU utilization and memory headroom snapshots as CSVs for charts.

Olivia: noted. add exact bench command to reproduce.

Ravi: example command we will run: `./bench_runner --model rdx-13b-v1 --quant int8 --batch 8 --concurrency 16 --steady 30 --repeat 5 --output /tmp/bench-2112` - we'll attach run_id, node list, seed. bench-bot will enqueue.

bench-bot: queued job 2112-rt-082 for rdx-13b-v1 (quant=int8).

Ravi: ETA ~24h for full sweep (fp16+int8, pooled + shard-median outputs, per-token traces). we'll tag runs with GPU mem spikes >90% and surface those separately.

Olivia: perfect. marketing will base the blog on pooled stats but include shard-median in appendix and note methodology. please post run_id and summary when complete. :+1:

Sam: small ask - if any runs show retries/ooms, flag them so we don't accidentally include inflated latencies.

Ravi: will attach raw logs and a tiny parsing script to regenerate CSVs and percentiles. we'll also include 10 sample prompts comparing outputs across variants so product/legal can review quality deltas.

Jordan: if int8 variance is high, include a short note about tradeoffs and whether warmup length affected tails.

Olivia: thanks all - really appreciate the quick turnaround :pray:
